verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK's entire surface (Agent, Runner.run()/run_sync()/run_streamed(), tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, MCP support) is documented as a public, programmable API in first-party docs and mirrored on the OpenAI developer docs hub, giving AI-native users a fully documented way to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of API completeness/stability and a formal machine-readable spec (the openapi.json probe returned 404s, though this is expected for an SDK rather than a REST service).
